# Camille Navarro — Executive Director, Keystone Education Alliance

- **Goes by:** Cam
- **Full name:** Camille Navarro
- **Role:** Executive Director (ED) of [Keystone Education Alliance](../context/company.md),
  a mid-size education nonprofit. Reports to the Board of Directors.
- **Reports to:** the Board, chaired by [Eleanor Foss](../people/eleanor-foss.md).
- **Background:** mission-driven and **non-technical** — came up through program work and
  community organizing, not finance or engineering. Ran the tutoring program herself for years
  before becoming ED in 2021. Leans on [Robert Kim](../people/robert-kim.md) for the numbers.
- **Tenure:** ED since 2021; ~9 years total at Keystone.

## Mandate
Lead Keystone Education Alliance — set strategy, own fundraising and donor relationships, steward
the ~**$6.8M** budget with the board, and represent the organization publicly. Cam runs a ~55-person
staff across four functions: Tutoring ([Sarah Chen](../people/sarah-chen.md)), College Access &
Mentoring ([Andre Willis](../people/andre-willis.md)), Development
([Daniela Cruz](../people/daniela-cruz.md)), and Finance & Operations
([Robert Kim](../people/robert-kim.md)).

## Current top priorities (FY27)
1. **Close the funding gap** left by the [Hearthstone Foundation grant](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md)
   renewal — this restricted grant underwrites the flagship
   [After-School Tutoring Program](../projects/after-school-tutoring.md).
2. **Fall programming** — launch the [Bright Futures — Fall Cohort](../projects/bright-futures-fall.md)
   mentoring program.
3. **Annual Gala** — hit the [Annual Gala 2026](../projects/annual-gala-2026.md) revenue target.
4. **Willow** — a confidential board matter (see code-name file).

## What's eating Cam's time
- Scrambling to backfill the tutoring program's funding after the grant news.
- The open Development Associate role since [Gregory Lang](../people/gregory-lang.md) left.
- Donor cultivation ahead of the gala.
- The confidential [Willow](../projects/willow.md) decision heading to the board.

## Working style
- Mission-first; wants the human impact, not just the metrics — but is trying to get more
  disciplined about the numbers.
- Prefers plain-language summaries; glazes over at jargon and spreadsheets.
- Deeply protective of donor relationships and program staff morale.
